# Test fixtures (#22)

Shared fixtures so checks are all tested against the same documents.

- `sample_report.json` — a hand-authored example of the `report.json` render
  contract (a slop proposal with citation, quote, AI-detection, and budget
  findings). Used by the report renderer tests.
- `synthetic/` — a labeled corpus of synthetic funding documents (grant
  applications, blog posts, and think-tank reports) with ground-truth defect
  labels, generated by `scripts/synth/`. Doubles as an eval set; see
  `synthetic/README.md`.

All fixtures are synthetic or public-domain — no real, non-public submissions
and no real applicant personal data, ever.
